subject: Launch cohort: combining promo credits + cohort sweetener — eligibility & exception path
messages:
From: Lina Costa <lina@orionaccelerator.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: orion-accounts@orionaccelerator.com
Date: Tue, 14 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Launch cohort — question on stacking startup promo credits with cohort sweetener

Hi Jordan / Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited about Redwood's latency/cost profile. We have a quick pricing question while we finalize the SOW for our new "Launch" cohort (SOW attached).

Our standard process: accepted founders get a $5k per-team promo credit from our general partnership funds. For the Launch cohort we also offer a "sweetener": an additional platform stipend (usually $2k) from our corporate sponsor to help with initial usage.

Two asks:
- Can Redwood allow the standard $5k promo credit to be used in combination with the Launch sweetener top-up for teams that convert to a pilot within 60 days?
- If this is allowed, can you provide any documentation we can include in the SOW so procurement understands the combined credit treatment and any billing implications?

We have procurement timelines to meet (PO by 6/1), so any guidance on how you normally handle stacking promo credits + cohort stipends would be very helpful.

Appended the draft SOW for context. Please loop in operations if needed.

Best,
Lina Costa
Head of Partnerships | Orion Accelerator
Orion Accelerator | lina@orionaccelerator.com

Attachment: Orion_SOW_launch-cohort.pdf (PDF, 410KB)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Costa <lina@orionaccelerator.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Launch cohort — question on stacking startup promo credits with cohort sweetener

Thanks Lina — great to see the SOW. Short answer: yes, we can usually support stacking the two credit sources, but there are a couple of conditions to make the accounting clean for both parties.

Quick summary of recommended path (high level):
- Promo credit ($5k) is applied first as a hosted API consumption subsidy tied to the receiving team's account ID.
- Launch sweetener ($2k) can be provided as a project-level top-up (restricted to cohort-tagged usage) or as a one-time invoice credit depending on how Orion wants to treat the sponsor funds.
- For procurement: we provide an "exceptions addendum" that references both credits and clarifies that the combo will not create double-billing for the host (Redwood) — credits reduce invoiced consumption until exhausted.

Action items I suggest:
1) We draft a 1-page addendum that you can attach to the SOW that explains stacking and the billing flow.
2) Ben and I will validate the accounting path with billing to ensure PO-friendly wording (esp. if Orion prefers Invoice Credit vs applied top-up).
3) Vanessa, can you put together a short template addendum and flag any compliance notes for procurement?

@Ben — curious if we can confirm the Invoice Credit vs top-up differences and any SLA or refund implications.

I can turn this around quickly if you want it by EOD Friday (5/18).

—Jordan
Jordan Blake

Subject: Re: Launch cohort — question on stacking startup promo credits with cohort sweetener

On Tue, May 14, 2028 at 10:05 AM Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks Lina — great to see the SOW. Short answer: yes, we can usually support stacking the two credit sources, but there are a couple of conditions to make the accounting clean for both parties.

Quick notes from billing ops:
- We prefer to apply the partnership promo credit ($5k) as account-level free credit first — it reduces metered consumption automatically.
- For a cohort "sweetener" we offer two default options: (A) project-restricted top-up (administered via our Console tagging + grant API) or (B) a vendor Invoice Credit which we issue on Orion's billing account once you provide the PO and sponsor confirmation.
- If Orion needs audit trails for turn-key procurement, option B (Invoice Credit) is cleaner because it shows a line item credit on the invoice — useful for sponsor accounting.

Constraints:
- We need to avoid double-application: rules must be ordered (promo then sweetener).
- If the sponsor requires multi-team pooling of the $2k (i.e., sponsor funds to be split across several teams), we need explicit allocation prior to grant issuance.

I'll assemble a one-page "stacking addendum" and attach draft billing language. Vanessa, I'm copying you for procurement wording and to surface any compliance flags.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Channel Sales | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0166

From: Lina Costa <lina@orionaccelerator.com>

Cc: orion-accounts@orionaccelerator.com
Date: Thu, 16 May 2028 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Launch cohort — question on stacking startup promo credits with cohort sweetener

Thanks Ben & Jordan — this looks promising and aligns with what procurement asked for. A couple of clarifications so we can finalize the PO: 

1) Sponsor wants the $2k to be issued as an Invoice Credit per team (option B) — that works best for their treasury team.
2) We will include a clause in our SOW that requires teams to convert to a paid pilot within 60 days for the credits to be stacked — can you confirm that the credits will only be stacked if the conversion condition is met (i.e., we can program the Console grant to only apply after the trigger)?

If you can confirm the conditional stacking and send the 1-page addendum + draft invoice-credit wording, we'll add it to the SOW and send the PO before 6/1.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Lina
Head of Partnerships | Orion Accelerator
